value: Decoder-only dense transformer (GraniteForCausalLM), 8B parameters: GQA with 32 attention heads and 8 KV heads, RoPE (θ = 10,000,000), SwiGLU MLP (hidden size 12800), RMSNorm (ε = 1e-5), untied input/output embeddings. The 8B Dense column lists 40 layers, embedding size 4096, attention head size 128. No experts or rationale for design choices stated (dense model).

value: Post-trained from Granite-4.1-8B-Base (pre-trained on a large-scale English and multilingual corpus) in a multi-stage pipeline of three stages: pre-training, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and multi-phase, multi-environment reinforcement learning using GRPO, followed by a preference-alignment (RLHF) phase.
quote: Granite-4.2-8B is post-trained from [Granite-4.1-8B-Base](https://huggingface.co/ibm-granite/granite-4.1-8b-base) through a rigorous multi-stage pipeline that progressively unlocks reasoning, tool use, and instruction-following capabilities. [...] The final stage of training applies multi-phase, multi-environment reinforcement learning using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). [...] After the reward-driven phases, a preference-alignment (RLHF) phase tunes helpfulness, conversational quality, and safety.
